```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (A B C : Set α) : A ∩ (B ∪ C) = (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ C) := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with h1 h2
    · exact Set.mem_union_left _ h1
    · exact Set.mem_union_right _ h2
  · intro h
    cases h with h1 h2
    · exact Set.mem_inter.mk h1 (Set.mem_union_left _ h1)
    · exact Set.mem_inter.mk h2 (Set.mem_union_right _ h2)
```
